{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check the revenue column for string format and thousands separators
print("First 5 values of revenue (as string):")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99:", (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Confirm the status column has only 'completed' and 'refunded'
print("Unique values in status:", data['status'].unique())

# Check the channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(data['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the customer_segment distribution
print("Customer segment distribution:")
print(data['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
